title: "Marketing on Start + Void"
description: "Native Marketing runtime, emitted-Worker qualification, route ownership, and the cutover and rollback runbook."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

Marketing (`apps/marketing`) is part of the TTR D74 Cloudflare migration, moving
public marketing and legal pages from Vercel to native Cloudflare Workers powered
by TanStack Start, Vite+, and Void SDK.

Its request context, Next.js shims (`next/headers`, `next/navigation`,
`next-intl/server`), Vite preset, and response policies come from
[`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge). The application maintains
its own Worker entrypoint (`cloudflare/worker.ts`), route tree, and layout hierarchy.

## Worker identity and mounts

The Worker targets the following staging and production identities:

- **Worker Name:** `tuturuuu-marketing` (production and staging candidate)
- **Root Hosts:** `marketing.tuturuuu.com`
- **Mount Hosts:** `tuturuuu.com`
- **Base Path:** `/marketing`

On the apex domain (`tuturuuu.com`), pages are mounted under `/marketing/*` or
routed via Cloudflare path routing rules. On the serving subdomain
(`marketing.tuturuuu.com`), pages are served directly from `/`.

## Bindings and configuration

The Worker requires only standard asset and routing bindings; **no secrets**
are placed on the Cloudflare Worker.

| Binding | Type | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ASSETS` | Asset binding | Serves static assets emitted into `dist/client`. |
| `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` | Environment variable (var) | Optional. Set to `"1"` on staging and preview deployments to prevent indexing. |
| `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` | Environment variable (var) | Optional. Origin for central internal API forwarding (defaults to `https://tuturuuu.com`). |

## Production indexing

Only `https://tuturuuu.com` may index the marketing allowlist in
`packages/utils/src/seo-policy.json`. The Worker imports the marketing entry and
passes it to the shared `appRobots` response policy; an explicit hostname guard
also keeps every other host private. Staging, preview, workers.dev and the
marketing subdomain remain `noindex`, even for `/`. Keep
`TUTURUUU_NOINDEX="1"` in staging and `"0"` or unset in production. Upstream
`noindex`, reserved private paths and other response security guards stay enforced.

The public scope covers the landing and pricing redirect; company pages;
privacy, terms, acceptable use, community guidelines and security; the enumerated
legal, security, product and solution pages; and the blog index. EN URLs and `/vi`
URLs share the allowlist. Unknown descendants and web-owned pass-through routes
are excluded. Regression coverage is in `apps/marketing/seo-policy.test.ts`,
including broken-policy and broken-header variants.

Release with rollback ready. After deployment, purge `/`, `/vi` and every public
marketing group, including locale variants, from the edge cache using the purge
credential. Verify `x-robots-tag` is absent on public production paths and present
on staging/workers.dev hosts and private paths. Roll back if those checks fail.

## Route groups and ownership

Route outcomes are declared in `start-bridge.routes.json` under `runtime` and
verified against workerd during CI qualification.

| Page group | Routes | Expected outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Landing & Core** | `/` | `200` |
| **Pricing** | `/pricing` | `307` redirect to `/?hash-nav=1#pricing` |
| **Contact** | `/contact` | `200` |
| **Company & Ecosystem** | `/about`, `/branding`, `/contributors`, `/careers`, `/partners`, `/women-in-tech` | `200` |
| **Content** | `/blog`, `/community-guidelines` | `200` |
| **Products & Solutions** | `/products`, `/products/tasks`, `/solutions/education` | `200` |
| **Trust & Legal** | `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/security`, `/security/bug-bounty`, `/security/policy`, `/legal/dpa`, `/legal/sla`, `/legal/subprocessors`, `/legal/changes` | `200` |

### Pass-through routes (retained in `apps/web` on Vercel)

The following routes are intentionally **not** ported to the Worker and stay in
`apps/web` on Vercel as gateway pass-through routes:

- `/download`
- `/models`
- `/changelog` (including `[slug]` articles and dynamic OG/Twitter image routes)

**Rationale:** These surfaces rely directly on the Supabase admin client
(`createAdminClient`) with `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, and `/download` depends on
per-request client detection headers. `apps/web` does not provide dedicated public
APIs for these operations. Injecting service-role credentials into the public
Cloudflare Worker is forbidden, and adding new backend endpoints would require
modifying `apps/web` (which is kept strictly untouched during this migration).
Routing rules on Cloudflare forward these paths directly to the Vercel deployment.

## Build and local verification

Local build prerequisites require compiling workspace package distributions
first so that Rolldown resolves dependencies:

```bash
# 1. Build workspace package dependencies
bun turbo:local run build --filter='@tuturuuu/marketing^...' --concurrency=2

# 2. Build Cloudflare Worker output
cd apps/marketing
bun run build:cloudflare
```

To run runtime verification and type checks:

```bash
# Execute runtime contract tests under workerd
CI=true bun run test:runtime

# Run Cloudflare TypeScript type check
bun run type-check:cloudflare
```

## Cutover and rollback runbook

### Prerequisites

1. **Vercel deployment ID:** The prior Vercel deployment ID is **not** recorded in
   the repository. Rex must capture and record the active immutable Vercel
   deployment ID and domain configuration before applying routing rules.
2. **Untouched origin:** `apps/web` remains deployed and functional on Vercel; no
   destructive changes or deletions are performed on the Vercel origin.

### Traffic cutover

1. Traffic cutover is performed progressively via Cloudflare route patterns
   assigned to the Worker.
2. Cloudflare routes are applied per page group (e.g. `/privacy`, `/terms`,
   `/security/*`, etc.).
3. Once routed, verify live smoke responses immediately.

### Smoke verification

Verify status codes and runtime identification header `x-tuturuuu-runtime: native`:

```bash
# English routes
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://<host>/privacy
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://<host>/terms
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://<host>/security

# Localized route
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://<host>/vi/privacy

# Header check
curl -sI https://<host>/privacy | grep -i x-tuturuuu-runtime
# Expected: x-tuturuuu-runtime: native
```

All status codes must return `200`, and `x-tuturuuu-runtime` must equal `native`.

### Rollback procedure

There is **no in-repo gateway feature flag** per page group.

- **Mechanism:** Per-group rollback is executed by removing that group's Cloudflare
  route pattern (owned by Rex).
- **Behavior:** Because `apps/web` on Vercel remains running and completely
  untouched, deleting or disabling the Cloudflare Worker route pattern immediately
  restores Vercel as the origin for that page group with zero downtime.
- **RTO:** Under 5 minutes without requiring repository commits or code rebuilds.
